title: Palladium-Engineered MgFeO3 Perovskite Nanostructures as Advanced Electrode Materials for High-Performance Asymmetric Supercapacitors
authors: Mohammed Y. Al-Quhali, Tariq M. Al-Hejri, Amat-Alrahman Othman, Shoyebmohamad F. Shaikh, Shyam K. Gore and Rajaram S. Mane
abstract: Capacitive energy storage offers rapid charging, long operational lifespan, and high power density. This work introduces a simple yet effective palladium (Pd)-doping strategy to enhance the electrochemical performance of perovskite-type magnesium ferrite (MgFeO3) nanostructures (Mg1−xPdxFeO3, PMFs), where “x” varies from 0 to 0.20. Pd incorporation modifies the crystallite size and Mg/Fe ratio, tuning the physical, chemical, and electrochemical properties.
